{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean and convert 'revenue' column
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Ensure 'status' is 'completed' for valid sales
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for any missing or invalid data
sales_df.isnull().sum(), sales_df.describe()"}
